sbh2.3:1.9: tatra yo hitādhyāśayaḥ, sukhopasaṁhārāya cādhimokṣaḥ samāhitabhūmikaḥ ayamālambaka iti |
sbh2.3:2.1: tatra yattāvadāha maitrīsahagatena cittenetyanena triṣu pakṣeṣu mitrapakṣe, amitrapakṣe, udāsīnapakṣe hitādhyāśaya ākhyātaḥ |
sbh2.3:2.4: tatrāvairatayā hitādhyāśayaḥ sā punaravairatā dvābhyāṁ padābhyāmākhyātāḥ |
sbh2.3:3.2: vipulena mahadgatena pramāṇenetyanena mṛdumadhyādhimātrasya sukhasyopasaṁhāra ākhyātaḥ |
sbh2.3:4.4: aduḥkhāsukhite mitrapakṣe, amitrapakṣe, udāsīnapakṣe, sukhakāme veditavyaḥ |
sbh2.3:4.5: yastu duḥkhito vā, aduḥkhito vā punarmitrapakṣaḥ |
sbh2.3:4.7: tatra yo duḥkhitaḥ sa karuṇāyā ālambanaṁ |
sbh2.3:4.8: yaḥ sukhitaḥ sa muditāyā ālambanamiyamucyate maitrī |
sbh2.3:5.1: tatra vyāpādacaritaḥ pudgalaḥ maitrīṁ bhāvayan sattveṣu yo vyāpādastaṁ pratanu karoti |
